topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Whispers of the wind carry the scent of distant pines, a soothing balm to the restless mind. The sun dips low, casting long shadows, and the urgency of the day fades with the light. A traveler's troubles, like the rest, shall pass, and new paths will reveal themselves in the morning. The earth does not rush; it moves in its own time, and so too must we. The rhythm of the forest, slow and steady, teaches patience. Night falls, and with it, rest. The stars above, countless and unchanging, remind us that in the grand tapestry of things, every thread has its place, every delay its purpose.
